records.subject: Prolonged oxidation
records.conditions: TiO2 oxidation at 1123 and 1323 K in gas with p(O2) = 75 kPa; electrical-property effects interpreted in terms of vacancy concentration.
records.quote: The present work reports the effects of prolonged oxidation of titanium dioxide on its semiconducting properties at elevated temperatures.
context_quotes: The studies were performed by using simultaneous measurements of both electrical conductivity and thermoelectric power during oxidation at 1123 and 1323 K in the gas phase of controlled oxygen activity, p(O-2) = 75 kPa.
The effects of oxidation on these electrical properties are considered in terms of a chance in the concentration of titanium vacancies, which are formed during oxidation.

records.subject: SWASV using carbon paste electrode modified with carbon black, sulphonic-group-functionalized resin and paraffin
records.object: Simultaneous quantification of Cd(II) and Pb(II) in cooling water
records.quote: A new, simple, sensitive and fast analytical method was developed to simultaneous quantification of Cd(II) and Pb(II) in cooling water by anodic square wave redissolution voltammetry (SWASV) using a modified carbon paste electrode composite with carbon black, resin functionalized with sulphonic group and paraffin.
context_quotes: The method was successfully applied in cooling water from thermoelectric industry and the concentrations of Cd(II) and Pb(II) were 3.27 +/- 0.30 and 2.80 +/- 0.18 mg l(-1), respectively.
modality_evidence: The method was successfully applied in cooling water from thermoelectric industry and the concentrations of Cd(II) and Pb(II) were 3.27 +/- 0.30 and 2.80 +/- 0.18 mg l(-1), respectively.
records.conditions: Successfully applied to cooling water from the thermoelectric industry; described as simple, sensitive and fast.

records.subject: Optimized electrolyte and SWASV conditions
records.object: Higher Cd(II) and Pb(II) peak currents
records.quote: A new, simple, sensitive and fast analytical method was developed to simultaneous quantification of Cd(II) and Pb(II) in cooling water by anodic square wave redissolution voltammetry (SWASV) using a modified carbon paste electrode composite with carbon black, resin functionalized with sulphonic group and paraffin.
context_quotes: The experimental conditions such as supporting electrolyte (composition, pH and ionic strength) and SWASV parameters were optimized.

The best conditions of Cd(II) and Pb(II) (higher peak current) were obtained in 0.1 mol l(-1) BR buffer (pH 4.6) from -1.1 to 0.3 V, amplitude of 60 mV, frequency of 40 Hz, potential step of 5 mV, potential and deposition time of -1.1 V and 240 s, respectively.
modality_evidence: The experimental conditions such as supporting electrolyte (composition, pH and ionic strength) and SWASV parameters were optimized.
